_comment: QuickBooks Online OAuth 2.0 credentials. Copy to ~/.config/bookie/qbo-credentials.json and fill in. Get client_id + client_secret from developer.intuit.com (create an app under My Hub > your workspace > your app > Keys & Credentials; use Development keys for sandbox, Production keys once your app is approved). Get realm_id + refresh_token by running the OAuth flow once (see README → 'Connect to QuickBooks Online'). Set environment to 'sandbox' or 'production'.
